info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Institutionlogin Account-spec
info.description: This API enables the creation of new institution login accounts tied to specific customers. By providing the customer ID and institution login ID, businesses can efficiently onboard and manage user accounts within their digital services. This functionality is particularly useful for financial institutions and service providers that need to connect customer accounts with institutional logins. Typical consumers include developers working on banking applications or financial platforms that require seamless account management.

post.summary: Create an account for an institution login.
post.description: This operation allows the creation of a new account associated with a specified institution login under a particular customer. Use this endpoint to prepare institutional integrations and manage accounts effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create an account associated with a specific institution login for a customer. It requires detailed account information to successfully process the request.
